configError.title: App not configured
configError.body: This build has no Gonarra server address, so it cannot load places, trips or the Guide. There is no offline demo data.
configError.fix: For developers: set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (for example http://192.168.1.20:8000, without /v1) in apps/mobile/.env, then restart the Expo server.

loadError.offline: Can't reach Gonarra. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.busy: The service is busy or paused. Please try again in a few minutes.
loadError.server: Gonarra's server ran into a problem. Please try again.
